text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel that selected a male candidate over you, also male, points nowhere useful. Sex can't plausibly explain a decision between two men made by men — there's no comparator of a different sex anywhere in the chain. Raising it would read as grasping, and it would undercut the complaint you actually have.

Your real grievance is substantive: fifteen years against eight, five as deputy, and a stated reason ("strong experience of digital media") that may or may not have been a published criterion. Push on that. Chase the written explanation in writing, citing the date of your request, and ask which criteria were scored and how. If digital wasn't advertised as essential, that's your argument.
